title: Intern - Luxury Events & Content Marketing

description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

 

This position is a hybrid role open to candidates in the greater Tampa Bay area. This position will require the intern to work in our Clearwater, FL office 4 days a week (Monday - Thursday).

Dates of Program: May 24th, 2027 - August 13, 2027 (12 weeks)

Application Dates: You should apply as soon as possible but understand that because of our large pool of applicants, the selection process can take a few weeks. We strive to create a diverse group of interns as we feel that it improves the overall internship experience.

Attention: This is a paid internship. Please note that the intern would be responsible for relocation (if needed) and lodging for the duration of the internship.

Internship Program Details: Join the best internship program around! Interns get unique insight into the minds of the CEO and senior executives during Ask Me Anything sessions. Interns will receive company training, onboarding, and professional development workshops to help transition into the workplace. Interns will also engage in team-building activities and awesome socials. For more information on the internship program, visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/internships. 

As a Sales Development Representative Intern at KnowBe4, you’ll see business through the lens of the provider of the world's largest integrated new-school security awareness training and simulated phishing platform as you grow your knowledge of KnowBe4’s products, systems, business operations, and sales strategies. The sales development internship program will give aspiring sales professionals exposure to real strategies and techniques applied in a working sales organization.  The individuals selected will be exposed to real sales conversations and get hands-on experience effectively finding, cleaning and prospecting new accounts to become KnowBe4 customers. You will work alongside current SDRs and interface with the Account Executives you will deliver to. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Map company structure and verify their information to find  workable accounts
  • Map and identify appropriate contacts from the workable accounts
  • Learn critical elements of prospecting conversations in preparation for qualification calls
  • Role-play to learn conversation best practices, mirroring, labeling, and objection-handling techniques
  • Conduct calls and emails to drive solid demo bookings
  • Schedule and hand-off demo ready lead to quota carrying Sales Representatives
  • Learn how to organize, clean, prospect, and maintain our CRM database
  • Shadow sales development representatives with prospective customers to grow in your conversation knowledge, understanding and skills
  • Listen to demos of sales calls from  Account Executives of varying levels of tenure
  • Work with cross-functional sales teams to understand the KnowBe4 business model better

Learning Objectives:

  • Get a full understanding of the Sales Roadmap to Success
  • Get a solid understanding of the Information Technology industry and the importance of security awareness training within a prospect’s organization 
  • Learn all critical elements of a solid sales prospecting process
  • Learn and complete a successful sales handoff from prospecting efforts 
  • Apply negotiating skills effectively
  • Translate classroom experience into practical application during the internship

Internship Opportunities/Experiences:

  • Attend all scheduled professional development events for the intern program
  • On-the-job training to learn the best business practices related to prospecting and sales 
  • Time with inspiring sales leaders who are committed to providing ongoing training & mentoring

Training:

  • Industry, KnowBe4 and Sales process training at the beginning of the internship
  • Learn key terms related to KnowBe4 and cybersecurity
  • Role-playing to learn conversation best practices, mirroring, labeling and objection-handling techniques
  • Learning best practice techniques for calling and emailing prospects
  • On-the-job training in key sales development steps and strong administrative disciplines 
  • Learn time management and balance of workload

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Strong Communication and Empathy
  • Confident and Positive
  • Resilient and Adaptable
  • Competitiveness and Tenacity
  • Collaborative Team Player

Lila Sciences is looking for a hands-on engineering co-op to help build and test the automated systems that run our laboratory workflows. Reporting to a senior manager on the Automated Systems Engineering team and paired with a day-to-day mentor, you will work alongside engineers and scientists on real workcells that are being deployed.

This is a lab-floor role. You will spend your time integrating instruments and troubleshooting systems that run live experiments. By the end of the co-op you should own a meaningful piece of a system and understand how scientific goals turn into working hardware.

Along the way you will see how scientific objectives become scoped technical requirements, how science, hardware, controls, and software teams coordinate interfaces on a shared system, and how automated experiments generate the structured, high-quality data that feeds AI-driven experimental design. You will also get hands-on time with emerging lab technology, including machine vision, advanced sensors, and automated scheduling software.

What You'll Be Building

  • Support cross-functional requirements gathering and project documentation using established team templates and execution guidelines.
  • Assist in converting manual scientific protocols into automation concept designs through process mapping, step timing, and identification of automation candidates.
  • Research new instruments and technologies, and help evaluate them for physical integration capability and fit with scientific workflows.
  • Contribute to concept design documentation, system architecture diagrams, and interface definitions for workcell- and instrument-level projects.
  • Maintain and update the federated factory layout model, producing layout drawings and 3D models that account for robotics envelopes, human ergonomics, and hazard zones.
  • Support feasibility assessments for proposed automation opportunities and help document lab automation best practices and lessons learned.

  • Working knowledge of Python through coursework, projects, or prior internships

description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is hiring a co-op to join the Materials Science team within the Autonomous Science Platform. You will characterize electrodeposited metal films and develop the measurement methods that make those results repeatable. Deposition is handled by other scientists on the team; your focus is measurement, method development, and data quality.

The role spans electrical, surface, structural, and mechanical techniques: four-point probe for sheet resistance and resistivity, laser confocal metrology for thickness, step height, and roughness, XRD and EBSD for phase, texture, and grain structure, and hardness testing for mechanical properties. Much of the work is standing these methods up: defining sample prep, acquisition settings, and acceptance criteria so results hold across operators and sample batches.

You will work alongside scientists and engineers in a lab built for high-throughput, automated experimentation, and your protocols will feed directly into how these measurements get scaled.

What You'll Be Building

  • Develop sample prep and measurement protocols for general characterization tools on electrodeposited films: four-point probe, hardness testing, and SEM/EBSD.
  • Prepare samples for SEM and EBSD (mounting, polishing, surface cleanup)
  • Run four-point probe, laser confocal metrology, and hardness measurements
  • Analyze XRD data (phase ID, texture, peak shift, crystallite size) and EBSD data (grain size, orientation, texture)
  • Validate measurement repeatability and establish data quality criteria
  • Analyze and visualize characterization data, then document methods and failure modes

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Pursuing a bachelor's, master's, or PhD in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mechanical/Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience operating materials characterization instruments in a lab

This co-op sits with the nucleic acid design group in LSAI, which builds models and design strategies for RNA and DNA sequences. You'll join our Nucleic Acid Design team for a 6-month co-op focused on open-ended research questions that could shape how Lila designs nucleic acid sequences in the future.

Your Impact at LILA

As a Co-Op on the Production Robotics team at Lila Sciences, you will help build the algorithms and software that let our robots know where they are and what they are looking at, so they can run scientific workflows reliably inside the AI Science Factories (AISFs). The team develops the state estimation, perception, and testing infrastructure that general-purpose robotic skills depend on.

Your work will sit at the intersection of estimation, computer vision, and robotics software. You will help improve how our mobile bases estimate their position and motion, develop camera-based detection and localization of AprilTags and lab instruments, and strengthen the simulation-based testing and CI that validate changes before they reach hardware. Expect a mix of writing production-quality software, applying math to real sensor data, and debugging real-world behavior on physical robots.

You will work alongside robotics engineers, AI researchers, and software engineers, with day-to-day support from the Production Robotics team. The output is software that runs in production lab environments and directly accelerates the rate at which Lila can run experiments.

What You'll Be Building

  • Fuse multi-sensor data to improve mobile base state estimation
  • Build camera-based AprilTag and instrument detection and localization for robot manipulation and navigation
  • Develop new robot capabilities in ROS 2 (Jazzy)
  • Expand simulation-based tests and CI pipelines so changes are validated before deployment on hardware
  • Evaluate estimation and perception performance on real robot data and contribute fixes back to the codebase
  • Ship production code alongside robotics, software, and AI engineers

description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila's SCADA system spans cloud and on-premise infrastructure: Ignition gateways on EC2, a historian on RDS PostgreSQL, MQTT brokers, and edge nodes at each site. Today no single view shows the health of all of it, so the team learns about failures from users rather than from monitoring.

As a co-op on the Hardware & Controls Engineering team, you will build that view: a live connectivity diagram showing how every piece connects and which links are up, backed by dashboards covering database, gateway, and edge node health. The work is read-only end to end, with read-only AWS access and SELECT-only database access, so you can explore the full system safely.

You will be based at our Alewife site in Cambridge, working alongside controls engineers and the IT/OT team. Expect wide exposure across AWS, Linux, industrial networking, Ignition, and data visualization, and a clear picture of how an industrial SCADA system fits together end to end.

What You'll Be Building

  • Build a live topology view of edge nodes, brokers, gateways, and databases with per-link status and last-seen timestamps
  • Surface RDS PostgreSQL health: CPU, memory, storage growth, connection counts, replication lag, and slow queries
  • Dashboard Ignition gateway and EC2 metrics, including JVM heap, tag quality, Sparkplug birth and death rates, and scan timing
  • Monitor on-premise edge nodes for reachability, uptime, resource use, and last publish time
  • Integrate existing sources (CloudWatch, Performance Insights, Ignition gateway metrics, broker status) into one interface
  • Document the setup so the team can extend and maintain it after the term ends

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field
  • Available full time for the Spring 2027 co-op term, on-site at Alewife
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting and data collection
  • Comfortable working in Linux from the command line
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals: IP addressing, subnets, ports, and routing
  • Clear written communication for documenting dashboards and findings

Bonus Points For

  • Exposure to AWS, particularly EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, or IAM
  • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, or similar observability tooling
  • Familiarity with Ignition, MQTT or Sparkplug, or other industrial SCADA tooling
  • JavaScript or React, useful for building inside Ignition Perspective

description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences builds AI systems that accelerate discovery across the physical and life sciences. Within Physical Sciences AI, we work with experimental teams to build autonomous discovery agents that decide which experiments Lila's AI Science Factories should run next.

Real scientific campaigns rarely look like textbook optimization problems. A single campaign can mix large discrete choices (which components, which recipe) with continuous settings (amounts, temperatures, times), pursue several objectives under hard constraints, and draw on evidence from literature and characterization data. Every experiment costs real time and materials. Off-the-shelf methods often struggle here, and they ignore the domain structure that could guide the search.

As a Bayesian Methods Co-Op, you will work alongside research scientists and engineers on a focused project within one broad question: how AI systems can make better experimental decisions. Depending on your background, that could mean building agents that choose the next experiment, testing when in-context learners can be trusted as decision-makers, or developing Bayesian strategies for tight experimental budgets. Your methods will be tested against live campaigns.

What You'll Be Building

  • Design and benchmark experiment-selection strategies that balance exploration and exploitation under realistic budgets
  • Build autonomous discovery agents that propose the next experiment from surrogate models
  • Develop in-context learning approaches inspired by Bayesian inference, evaluating calibration and robustness
  • Run retrospective and live evaluations on active campaign data with clear baselines and metrics
  • Present findings to ML and experimental teams, with the option to contribute to a publication

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Pursuing a Master's or PhD in statistics, ML, CS, operations research, applied math, or a quantitative science
  • Solid grounding in Bayesian inference and decision making, including priors and posterior predictive distributions
  • Research experience in Gaussian processes, Bayesian optimization, bandits, reinforcement learning, or probabilistic modeling
  • Strong Python skills with PyTorch and probabilistic libraries such as Pyro, PyMC, or BoTorch
  • Comfort working with small, noisy, and heterogeneous datasets
  • Clear communication with both ML and experimental collaborators

Bonus Points For

  • Applying these methods to real problems in materials science, chemistry, or another physical science
  • Familiarity with in-context learning as implicit Bayesian inference, meta-learning, or prior-data fitted networks
  • Optimization over categorical or combinatorial spaces, including mixed-variable, multi-objective, or batch settings
  • Reinforcement learning for sequential decision making or Bayesian experimental design
  • Training models on multimodal scientific data such as text, images, spectra, or simulations

description:
About Moment Energy

Independent energy is here. Help us deploy it.

Energy should be free.  Free from aging grids, fragile supply chains, and unnecessary extraction. At Moment Energy, we’re building a world where clean power is abundant, affordable, and uninterrupted for everyone.

The world doesn’t need another promise about energy; it needs proof that a freer future is possible. Moment Energy is the pragmatic liberator of power, the only company certified to turn the largest untapped energy supply into independent energy.

Now is the moment. While the industry scraps millions of batteries with decades of life left, we put them to work by repurposing large-format batteries into advanced battery energy storage systems that deliver real-world impact.

We were told second-life batteries would never be safe enough or scalable enough. We didn’t argue, we engineered the solution. Today, Moment Energy delivers 5x the energy density and holds the certifications required to deploy energy independence at scale.

Now is the moment. Join us.

The Opportunity

Moment Energy is seeking a Certification Engineering Co-op to support our Certification Engineer in researching, coordinating, and documenting the regulatory requirements that allow our battery energy storage systems to be safely certified and deployed.

This is a hands-on learning opportunity for an engineering student interested in product safety, electrical systems, battery technology, and industry certification standards. You will work closely with engineering, production, and quality teams at our Megafactory in Surrey while gaining exposure to the certification processes behind commercial-scale energy storage products.

You'll help organize technical documentation, research applicable standards, track certification activities, and support preparation for testing and compliance reviews. Your work will contribute directly to bringing innovative energy storage products to market.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Research and summarize applicable certification standards and regulatory requirements, including CSA, UL, and NFPA standards.
  • Support the Certification Engineers in understanding and documenting requirements related to UL 1974, UL 1973, UL 9540, and UL 9540A.
  • Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, and product documentation to help identify information required for certification.
  • Maintain organized certification documentation, technical records, test reports, and compliance evidence.
  • Assist with tracking certification milestones, project timelines, outstanding requirements, and action items.
  • Support preparation for certification testing by coordinating documentation, product samples, and technical information.
  • Assist with communication and information gathering between engineering, production, quality teams, and external testing laboratories.
  • Research certification and regulatory requirements for new markets and energy storage applications.
  • Help identify gaps in technical documentation and follow up with relevant engineering teams to obtain outstanding information.
  • Contribute to improving internal documentation processes, compliance tracking tools, and certification workflows.

The Candidate

We're looking for an individual who is curious, detail-oriented, and eager to learn how complex electrical products are tested, evaluated, and certified.

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, or another related engineering discipline.
  • Strong research, analytical, and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to review technical information, identify key requirements, and summarize findings clearly.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and willingness to ask questions, seek clarification, and learn from others.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced engineering and manufacturing environment.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Previous co-op, internship, or academic project experience involving electrical systems, batteries, or hardware products.
  • Familiarity with technical standards, regulatory requirements, or product safety testing.

description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities.

Important Notice: ⚠️ To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: San Jose, California (Hybrid)
Salary: USD 30 - USD 40 per hour
Type: Full Time Internship (June 1, 2027 - August 31, 2027)

The Role

We are a passionate team of engineers, designers, and artists building active, camera-based games for Nex Playground. Our products span fitness, character-driven action, family party play, and experimental new formats, including:

  • Fitness & training: NexGym, Zumba Fitness Party, Family Fitness Challenge, and Training Ground.
  • Party & Action: Kung Fu Panda: Train Like A Master and Copy Cat Deluxe.

As our Software Engineer Intern (Game Development), you will work with the US game development team on production games, content updates, and new prototypes. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, designers, and artists to turn gameplay ideas into responsive motion controls, polished game systems, and fun physical experiences for players of all ages.

What You Will Bring to the Table

  • Build high-quality motion-based gameplay experiences using Unity, C#, and Nex's proprietary motion engine.
  • Contribute directly to production games and content updates, iterating on features to improve the player experience.
  • Brainstorm, prototype, and evaluate new game ideas in close collaboration with designers and fellow engineers.
  • Participate in playtesting, technical discussions, knowledge sharing, and code reviews.

Should Have

  • Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program at an accredited college or university.
  • Solid foundation in software development and algorithms.
  • Passion for games and curiosity about what makes them fun.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Care for users and attention to detail when building products and features.
  • Growth mindset and excitement for working in a fast-paced environment.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with Unity and C# is helpful, but not expected at the start; our onboarding includes training for interns who are new to the engine.
  • Experience with gameplay systems, motion controls, physics, UI/UX, tools, prototypes, or game jams.
  • Interest in fitness, family play, party games, or creative physical gaming experiences.

We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Flexible working hours and vacation policy.
  • Product-driven culture that treasures talent

description:
Are you a curious, analytical student who wants to see how strategy decisions get made at a fast-growing payments company? As a Business Strategy Intern on NMI’s Revenue Acceleration team, you’ll own strategic projects for our leadership team, covering pricing, monetization and competitive strategy across the payments and fintech landscape.

This is a US remote internship for Summer 2027, running 11–13 weeks. You’ll use AI throughout your work, partner with stakeholders across the business, and end the summer by presenting your findings and recommendations to our executive team. Working hours are 8am–5pm, Monday through Friday in your local time zone. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones, but welcome applicants from anywhere in the US.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You’ve probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We’re the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We’re creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what’s possible so they can think about what’s next. But we’re not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It’s Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn’t enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

What will I be doing?

  • Analyze pricing and monetization approaches across the payments and fintech industry, and turn them into practical recommendations for NMI.
  • Research the competitive landscape, including competitors’ product strategy, packaging, go-to-market approach and AI capabilities.
  • Use AI throughout your work, including agentic AI, generative AI and other AI tools, to research, analyze data, build models and create deliverables faster and at a higher level.
  • Build business cases and financial models that help leadership evaluate strategic opportunities.
  • Create reusable assets, such as competitive trackers and comparison frameworks, that the team can maintain and update over time.
  • Turn your analysis into executive-ready briefs and presentations, and refine them with input from cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Present your findings and recommendations to NMI’s executive team at the end of the summer.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Business, Finance, Economics or a related field, and returning to school after the internship (not graduating in 2027).
  • Prior professional experience, such as a previous internship or part-time role.
  • Strong financial modeling and Excel skills, with the ability to build models that support business decisions.
  • Clear, structured written and verbal communication, and confidence presenting to senior audiences.
  • A genuine interest in payments, pricing and strategy. Payments experience isn’t required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in consulting, banking, corporate strategy or fintech.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools, especially Tableau.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don’t feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the ‘Additional Info’ box on our application to tell us more about your path.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

  • A remote first culture!
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership and a dedicated mentor
  • Real projects that make an impact, ending in a final presentation to the executive team

Please note: This is a summer internship and does not convert into a full-time role at the end of the program. Interns are welcome to apply to open positions across NMI through the standard hiring process after finishing their degrees.

We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. We’re focused on making NMI more diverse and welcoming with initiatives like having a dedicated Diversity, Equity & Inclusion action group,

description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Software Engineering Interns

Parallel Systems is seeking Software Engineering Interns to help build the software that runs our vehicles and the platform behind our fleet. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to ship real work. Your code will run on prototype vehicles, on test benches, or in the services and tools our team and operators rely on every day.

Interns are placed on a vehicle software or backend/full-stack project based on their background and team priorities. You will own a scoped project from requirements through delivery, work closely with a mentor, and see your work tested on real hardware or used by real users.

The right person is curious beyond their own layer. Whether you are writing firmware, building a service, or shipping an internal tool, you will learn how software, hardware, and vehicle data fit together, and you will be comfortable debugging across those boundaries.

What You Will Work On

You will contribute to a specific project scoped to team priorities. Example areas include:

  • Vehicle control software: writing and testing code for braking, drivetrain, actuators, and power systems on microcontrollers or embedded Linux
  • Vehicle communications: developing and validating interfaces across CAN, Ethernet, SPI, I2C, or UART, including bench debugging
  • Sensor and diagnostics integration: bringing up onboard sensors and devices used for telemetry, health monitoring, and vehicle operation
  • Fleet and telemetry services: building services and data pipelines that ingest, store, and serve data from vehicles in the field
  • Fleet operations tools: building APIs and web applications used to monitor, dispatch, and manage vehicles
  • Developer and test infrastructure: improving CI/CD, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, deployment, and observability for the software team

Regardless of project, you will work through a structured engineering lifecycle: requirements review, design, implementation, testing, and documentation of results.

What to Expect

  • Weeks 1-2: Onboarding, vehicle and software platform architecture overview, development environment setup, lab and shop orientation, codebase familiarization, and a first starter task
  • Weeks 3-4: Project assignment, review of requirements and interfaces, and initial design and debugging work with your mentor
  • Weeks 5-7: Core implementation, testing on the bench or in staging, and iteration through code and design reviews
  • Weeks 8-10: Integration onto prototype vehicles or into production systems, test execution, issue investigation, and participation in team design reviews
  • Weeks 11-12: Final validation and handoff, documentation of findings and recommended next steps, and a presentation of results to the broader engineering team

Progress will be tracked through weekly check-ins with your mentor, design and code reviews, and feedback from the broader engineering team.

Basic Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related field
  • Hands-on software experience through internships, student teams, research, coursework, or personal projects
  • Strong programming skills in at least one language such as Rust, C, C++, Python, Go, or TypeScript
  • A track record of building software that works in the real world, not only in class assignments or simulation
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug issues across system boundaries
  • Clear communication, and comfort asking questions and sharing progress early
  • Excitement about working in a hands-on, hard-tech environment where software meets physical vehicles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Rust, C, or C++ on microcontrollers or embedded Linux
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, or Ethernet
  • Experience building APIs, distributed services, data pipelines, or full-stack web applications
  • Familiarity with databases, cloud infrastructure, containers, or CI/CD
  • Exposure to RTOS environments, simulation, or hardware-in-the-loop testing
  • Experience bringing up sensors, actuators, motor controllers, or other real electromechanical systems
  • Experience from hands-on extracurricular engineering teams such as Formula SAE, Baja SAE, robotics, rocket club, solar car, autonomous systems teams, or similar
  • Strong documentation habits and attention to detail

Please note the hourly range in the job posting reflects the new hire hourly range across levels that would be applicable to the position. Final compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s final level. Also, this range represents base compensation only and does not include equity or benefits, if applicable.

Target Hourly Range:
$50—$50 USD

description:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Product Management Intern

Parallel Systems is seeking a Product Intern to help shape the software platform that our team, operators, and rail partners use to run an autonomous freight network. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own a real product problem, not shadow one.

You will sit at the intersection of engineering, operations, and customers. You will talk to users, dig into data, define requirements, and work side by side with software engineers to scope and ship a feature on our platform.

The right person is technical enough to earn engineers' trust, curious enough to understand how rail and logistics actually work, and comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous problems.

What You Will Work On

You will own a specific product problem on our software platform, scoped to team priorities. Example areas include:

  • User and customer research: interviewing operators, rail partners, and internal teams to understand workflows and pain points
  • Requirements and specs: turning research into clear problem statements, user stories, and requirements engineers can build from
  • Feature delivery: working with engineering and design to scope, prioritize, build, and launch a feature on the platform
  • Fleet operations workflows: improving how users monitor, dispatch, and manage vehicles and freight through our tools
  • Data and metrics: defining success metrics, querying fleet and usage data, and turning findings into product decisions
  • Roadmap input: assessing opportunities, competitive landscape, and tradeoffs to inform what the team builds next

You will work through a structured product lifecycle: discovery, problem definition, requirements, delivery with engineering, launch, and measuring results.

What to Expect

  • Weeks 1-2: Onboarding, overview of our vehicles, operations, and software platform, shadowing engineers and operators, and tool and data access setup
  • Weeks 3-4: Project assignment, user interviews and discovery, and a written problem statement reviewed with your mentor
  • Weeks 5-7: Requirements and spec writing, prioritization with engineering, and early design or prototype reviews
  • Weeks 8-10: Supporting build and testing with the engineering team, user feedback sessions, and iteration on scope
  • Weeks 11-12: Launch or handoff, measurement of early results, documentation of findings and recommended next steps, and a presentation to the broader team

Progress will be tracked through weekly check-ins with your mentor, spec and design reviews, and feedback from engineering, operations, and users.

Basic Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Hands-on product, engineering, or startup experience through internships, student teams, research, or personal projects
  • Enough technical fluency to read code, understand system architecture, and discuss tradeoffs with engineers
  • Experience working with data, such as writing SQL or analyzing data in Python or spreadsheets
  • Strong written communication, including the ability to write clear, concise specs and documents
  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems and drive work forward with limited direction
  • Excitement about working in a hard-tech environment where software meets physical vehicles and real operations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior software engineering or product management internship, or experience shipping a software product at a startup or on a student team
  • Experience conducting user interviews or usability testing and translating findings into requirements
  • Experience building prototypes or simple apps, or comfort with design tools such as Figma
  • Familiarity with B2B, enterprise, or operations software
  • Interest in logistics, transportation, rail, robotics, or industrial technology
  • Experience from hands-on extracurricular engineering teams such as Formula SAE, robotics, autonomous systems teams, or similar
  • Strong documentation habits and attention to detail

Learn more by visiting PerScholas.org and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Location: United States

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The Space Operations team is crucial to Planet's success, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the health and productivity of the world's largest Earth Observation satellite constellation. Our team spans North America and Berlin. Given the scale of our fleet, automation is at the heart of our operations. You'll develop and maintain critical software, transforming large datasets into actionable metrics.

As a Working Student, you'll support daily satellite operations, analyze data, triage and resolve anomalies, run on-orbit experiments, test and deploy software both on the ground and in orbit, and commission satellites. You'll work closely with hardware and software experts across teams to debug anomalies, enhance or create services, and provide operational insights to shape our next-generation satellites. 

We are looking for a data-driven self-starter with effective communication skills that collaborates well within a technical team and adapts quickly to changing tasks and contexts.

This part-time, hybrid role is based at our Berlin office which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Develop and maintain real-time, mission-critical software solutions for satellite operations
  • Write scripts to aggregate satellite data and generate system monitoring metrics
  • Analyze data to identify issues and inefficiencies in the full stack of services and propose solutions to improve productivity
  • Drive improvements to fleet capacity and productivity through process enhancements
  • Monitor satellite health and perform on-orbit experiments

What You Bring:

  • Ongoing BSc in engineering or computer science
  • Proficiency in software development, particularly in Python or equivalent languages
  • Data-driven mindset with experience in statistical analysis
  • Proactive, self-starter approach to engineering and problem-solving
  • Effective interpersonal and collaboration skills within a technical team

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with agile software development
  • Experience with DevOps tools and practices (e.g., Git, GitLab, Docker, Jenkins, Bash, Linux, CI/CD, Sentry, Datadog)
  • Familiarity with satellite engineering and/or the space environment and its challenges
  • Hands-on experience operating spacecraft or remote systems
  • Familiarity with automation and optimization tools
  • Contributions to open-source software projects

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Export Control Requirements:

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

  • Employee Wellness Program 
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement

  • Equity 
  • Volunteering Paid Time Off

The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.

Who is Re:Build Manufacturing?

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. The Re:Build Way principles

Who is Re:Build Fikst?

Re:Build Fikst, a Re:Build Manufacturing company, is a dynamic product development and engineering consulting firm located in Wilmington, MA. We work with pioneering clients to develop their technology, design their products, and bring those products to production. Re:Build Fikst's areas of expertise include biomedical instruments and consumables, microfluidics, specialty plastic design, optics, industrial automation, robotics, and design for manufacturing. We have extensive in-house laboratory and rapid prototyping capability including CNCs, 3D printers, waterjet and laser cutters, which help facilitate our ability to prototype and innovate fast. As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we are able to collaborate with other member sites and leverage a greater network of capabilities including composites, industrial design, structural analysis, and embedded systems design.

Who we are looking for

  • Creative problem solvers who can connect scientific theory with engineering design to create novel products.
  • Strong communicators who can convey why their designs are good and appropriate solutions to our clients’ challenges.
  • Hands-on craftspeople who like to build breadboards and refined prototypes.
  • Life-long learners who can take on a challenge in a field new to them and quickly contribute to solutions.
  • Collaborators that enjoy working on technical teams that regularly include scientists, electrical engineers, optical engineers, manufacturing partners, and industrial designers.
  • Results oriented engineers who want to work in a streamlined environment that has the right tools to get the job done and minimizes bottlenecks.

What you'll get to do

We’re hiring mechanical engineering interns excited about product development. In this role engineers will gain experience with mechanical design and consulting. Engineers will work on product development teams to bring new products and technologies to market. They will gain experience developing designs, building and testing prototypes, and using the knowledge gained through testing to refine and improve on previous designs. Fikst’s projects are all hands-on and our prototyping shop includes CNC mills, lathe, 3D-printers, laser cutters and a variety of other scientific and engineering equipment. Engineers will also gain experience meeting with and presenting to clients. This role is intended to last at least three months and ideally could last up to six months. Timing and start dates will be discussed during the interview process. 

What you bring to the Team

  • In the process of a B.S.M.E.
  • Broad technical background and the desire to learn more
  • 3D CAD experience (Solidworks preferred)
  • Experience with a range of manufacturing processes (injection molding, machining, sheet metal, casting, etc.)
  • Experience designing biomedical products

Additional Details

When: June 2027

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $25.00 - $31.00. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting.  Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to hourly rate, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits

The BIG payoff

We are a company that is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.

Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all company levels!

Why RoboForce

RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company’s robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real-world deployment and scalability.

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer Intern to join us in developing advanced AI capabilities for robotics. The internship starts from November 2026 for 3-6 months. As part of our team, you will help build the foundational AI ecosystem, spanning data collection, labeling, training, evaluation, and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a team of world-class AI engineers and gain hands-on experience solving real-world challenges at the intersection of artificial intelligence and robotics.

Responsibilities

  • Train and improve robot foundation models, including vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models, for precise, contact-rich manipulation in industrial settings.

  • Explore new modalities and methods, including tactile and force-torque sensing, reinforcement learning, and simulation, to advance model capabilities.

  • Build data pipelines for robot learning, including data collection, curation, labeling, and dataset quality assurance.

  • Design and run evaluations in simulation and on real robots to measure and improve model performance.

  • Deploy models on robots and optimize them for real-time onboard inference.

  • Work closely with robotics, hardware, and product teams to bring models from research to production.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an advanced degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field, with a graduation date in 2026 or 2027.

  • Proficiency in multimodal models, modern machine learning architectures (e.g., transformers and diffusion models), and reinforcement learning.

  • Proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.

  • Requires 5 days/week in-office collaboration with the teams.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Exposure to robot learning using tactile and/or vision-based sensors.

  • Expertise in object pose estimation, bimanual manipulation, and synthetic data.

Duration:
  • 3–6 months, full-time
Compensation: 
  • $5,000 - $6,500 monthly salary

description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Fraud Operations intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Shopper Risk Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Interns will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time during the days and hours listed below:

  • Monday - Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - local time.

This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do:

  • Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.
  • Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.
  • Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.
  • Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.
  • Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.
  • Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.
  • Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

What We Look For:

  • Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Fraud Operations Intern is $800 USD gross monthly.

Stripe's Applied ML, Data Science, Risk, and Payments organizations are excited to offer PhD machine learning engineering internships for the summer of 2027. description:
5G SA O-RAN Test Bed Co-Op (Engineering Co-Op)

This is a full-time, in-person role at our Woburn, MA office. We are ideally seeking someone who can start in January 2027.

Are you interested in exploring the future of wireless communications and gaining hands-on experience with next generation 5G technologies? At STR, interns work alongside experienced engineers and software developers on meaningful projects that address challenging technical problems related to national security.

Our internship program gives you the opportunity to gain practical engineering experience, learn from experienced mentors, and develop skills in open-source software, Linux-based networking, and wireless communications. You’ll work in a collaborative engineering environment while contributing to the development and integration of emerging 5G technologies.

As part of the intelligence team, you’ll help establish and maintain a 5G Standalone (SA) Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) test bed using open-source software, including the Linux Foundation’s O-CU/DU and complementary components. You’ll gain hands-on experience configuring network and RAN components, integrating core-network systems, automating test-bed deployments, and troubleshooting interoperability challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Assist the team in establishing and maintaining a 5G Standalone (SA) O-RAN test bed using open-source software.
  • Install, configure, and maintain Linux-based networking and Radio Access Network (RAN) components.
  • Collaborate with the software development team to integrate core-network and O-RAN components.
  • Develop scripts and automation tools to support repeatable test-bed setup and configuration.
  • Troubleshoot networking, integration, and interoperability issues across system components.
  • Document system configurations, test procedures, troubleshooting processes, and experimental results.
  • Participate in hands-on lab experimentation and learn about emerging 5G technologies and open-source wireless systems.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or a related technical discipline.
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
  • Comfortable working in a Linux-based development environment.
  • Some experience with Python or shell scripting.
  • Interest in 5G wireless communications, Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN), and open-source software.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with software developers and engineering teams.
  • U.S. citizenship is required due to the nature of STR’s work and clearance requirements.

Perks:

  • Competitive pay
  • Flexible working hours
  • Fun activities both in and outside the office

Pay Information
Hourly Range: $25.20-$54.00/hour

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.


STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

description:
About the Developer Experience team

The Developer Experience (DevX) team owns how developers learn and build on Together AI. We run the documentation site, API reference, quickstarts, cookbooks, and the tooling that keeps all of it accurate as the platform ships new models and features every week.

We treat docs as a product and as code. Content lives in Git, publishes through Mintlify, and stays in sync with the API through CI/CD automation built on GitHub Actions. We also write for two audiences at once: the human developer reading a guide, and the AI coding agent pulling our docs into its context window. That means a house style guide built for AI-assisted authoring, structured content agents can parse, and automated review passes that check drafts against our quality bar.

Role Overview

As a Technical Writer Intern on DevX, you will write, test, and ship documentation that thousands of developers use to build with open-weight models. You'll be paired with a DevX mentor and own significant projects end to end, from scoping through launch, with real users and real metrics at the finish line. 

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll run the code you document, call our APIs, and open pull requests against the docs repo from your first week.

Potential projects include:

  • Build a closed-to-open migration kit
  • Make a docs section agent-ready, and prove it
  • Generate the CLI reference from source
  • Write an evaluation design tutorial series

Responsibilities

  • Write clear, accurate guides, tutorials, and reference content for Together AI's inference, fine-tuning, and GPU cluster products.
  • Work with engineers, product managers, and researchers to understand new features well enough to explain them simply.
  • Use AI tools in your daily workflow, and help us improve how we use them for drafting, editorial review, and publishing.
  • Test every feature you document by running the code yourself, and file bugs when the product or the docs don't behave as expected.
  • Draft, review, and publish in a docs-as-code workflow: Git, pull requests, code review, and Mintlify.
  • Contribute to release notes and changelog entries as features launch.
  • Use page analytics, search data, and developer feedback to decide what to improve next.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in Computer Science, Technical Communication, or a related field, graduating December 2027 or later.
  • Exceptional written communication: you can make a complex technical idea clear and approachable.
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming language (Python or TypeScript preferred) and comfort with Git source control.
  • Curiosity about how developers learn, and how AI is changing the way they do it.

Nice to have

  • Experience calling an LLM API or building a small project with AI tools.
  • Familiarity with Markdown/MDX, static site generators, or docs platforms like Mintlify or Docusaurus.
  • Experience with CI tools such as GitHub Actions.

Writing sample

Your application should include one or two writing samples, representing what you think is your own best work. The subject doesn’t have to be technical, or even nonfiction—though both are a plus! For example:

  • A technical blog post.
  • A README, tutorial, or contribution to open-source docs.
  • A research paper.
  • A personal essay.
  • A school newspaper submission.

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Internship Program Details: 

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span either May 17th to August 6th or June 14th to September 3rd. 

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $41 a hour. Our hourly rates are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Application Policy

Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

Introduction: 

Our Solutions Group analyzes the financial performance of our software product portfolio and the drivers of our P&L. We’re looking for an analytically strong, business-minded student to make our forecasting more predictive and more robust. You’ll work deeply with Salesforce pipeline data and build models that segment and score opportunities, forecast revenue, and surface the leading indicators behind forecast outcomes. You’ll also turn that work into insights that shape business planning.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Predictive forecasting: Develop and enhance predictive models that improve revenue forecasting accuracy, strengthen pipeline visibility, and give forward-looking insight into revenue performance.
  • Pipeline analytics: Analyze Salesforce opportunity and pipeline data to find patterns in deal progression, stage conversion, win rates, deal velocity, and revenue realization.
  • Modeling and segmentation: Apply statistical analysis, clustering, regression, classification, and other techniques to segment opportunities, estimate their likelihood and revenue potential, and identify the key drivers of forecast outcomes.
  • Risk and leading indicators: Identify leading indicators, pipeline risks, and emerging trends to explain forecast variability and improve the reliability of revenue projections.
  • Data modeling and pipeline building: Explore and document Salesforce data structures, and build clean, well-modeled datasets and data pipelines to support repeatable analysis and modeling.
  • Portfolio and P&L context: Connect pipeline analytics to broader revenue expectations, software portfolio performance, and the drivers of the P&L.
  • Insight to action: Translate complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations for business planning and decision-making for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Applied ML and AI: Explore and prototype ways machine learning, LLMs, and AI agents can strengthen our analytics, such as extracting signal from opportunity notes and unstructured CRM fields or automating multi-step analytical workflows.
  • Continuous improvement: Build scalable, repeatable analytical processes, and monitor, backtest, and refine models over time to improve forecast reliability.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be able to work on-site at our Durham, NC headquarters at least one day per week; two days preferred.
  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, AI, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Strong experience building, validating, and refining predictive models (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, time-series forecasting) through work, internships, research, or substantial projects.
  • Strong understanding of AI/LLMs, including how they work, their limitations, and where they can be applied to analytics.
  • Experience working with Salesforce or other CRM data, including opportunities, stages, accounts, and pipeline history.
  • Proficiency in Python or R, including common data science libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn.
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large, messy, real-world datasets.
  • Working knowledge of Excel and Microsoft Power Platform tools (e.g., Power Query, Power Automate) to analyze data and automate workflows.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Excellent business judgment, strong analytical thinking, and attention to detail, with the ability to explain technical results clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to experiment with new technologies, take ownership of tasks, and learn through hands-on problem-solving.

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Pursuing a master’s degree in a quantitative or analytics-focused program.
  • Coursework, internship, or project experience in finance, accounting, FP&A, or revenue/sales operations.
  • Basic understanding of P&L structure and how revenue drivers affect financial performance.
  • Experience with agentic AI, AI agents, and multi-step AI workflows.

title: AI Software Engineering Intern

description:
Who is Trace3?

Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate.

Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it!

Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco.  

Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

 

Come Join Us!

Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times

We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems.

Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover

We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart

We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

 

JOB SUMMARY:

As part of the Trace3xperience Program, the Workplace AI Tracer (Intern) will help Trace3 evaluate, compare, and position the leading enterprise workplace AI platforms, including Anthropic Claude, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Meta AI, and OpenAI ChatGPT. Reporting to the Vice President of Total Experience, the Tracer will work closely with the Practice Directors of Intelligent Enterprise, Customer Experience, and AI Solutions to build hands-on platform expertise, earn manufacturer certifications, and create an enterprise-level platform comparison that Trace3 teams and clients will use to make better decisions. The Tracer will also support pre-sales scoping and manufacturer partnership programs, and partner with fellow Tracers across groups such as AI Governance to connect Trace3's AI offerings and speed up the sale of its AI portfolio.

Tracers in this program will receive accelerated professional development, exposure to all technical functions of an IT consulting organization, world-class mentoring, and unique networking opportunities across the organization.

 

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO LEARN AND DO:

  • Study each workplace AI platform in depth: core capabilities, architecture, integrations, security and data controls, admin and governance features, and product roadmap
  • Complete manufacturer training and certification courses for Anthropic, Glean, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and OpenAI platforms as available
  • Build and maintain an enterprise-level comparison of the platforms, covering technical capabilities, security and compliance, deployment considerations, and commercial models such as licensing, pricing, and consumption
  • Present the platform comparison and related findings to internal Trace3 audiences, including sellers, solution architects, and practice leaders, as well as to Trace3 clients
  • Assist with pre-sales scoping, including discovery preparation, requirements gathering, use case identification, and solution summaries
  • Help clients understand the differences between platforms from both a technology and a commercial standpoint, so they can choose the right fit for their organization
  • Support Trace3's partnership programs with these manufacturers, including tracking program requirements, certifications, incentives, and partner enablement
  • Work with the Intelligent Enterprise, Customer Experience, and AI Solutions Practice Directors to map each platform to their portfolios and identify where Trace3 services fit
  • Collaborate with Tracers from other groups, such as AI Governance, to connect offerings across teams and build joint stories that accelerate the sale of Trace3's AI portfolio
  • Learn how an IT solutions provider evaluates emerging technology, builds partner relationships, and takes new offerings to market

 

ELIGIBILITY AND PREFERRED SKILLS:

  • Enrollment in the Junior or Senior year of an undergraduate program, at an accredited college or university or Masters program
  • Candidates should be pursuing a field of study applicable to the Workplace AI Pre-Sales internship, such as Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
  • Cumulative grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 or better; People and Organizational Health may require a copy of the applicant’s transcript
  • Academic or pro

Como Practicante de AP/AR en Uber Freight, obtendrás experiencia práctica en contabilidad y finanzas.   • Front Office: Redacción de correos electrónicos, gestión de calendario.

  • Habilidades: Pensamiento analítico, resolución de problemas, multitarea, gestión del tiempo, comunicación asertiva (escrita y verbal) en español e inglés.

  • Realizar actividades de conciliación y seguimiento de transacciones financieras.

  • Colaborar en la identificación y resolución de discrepancias en los procesos de pago.
  • Participar en actividades operativas y administrativas asociadas a la gestión financiera.

 

 

Acerca de Uber Freight 

Uber Freight ayuda a las empresas a mover mercancías de manera más confiable y eficiente. Reunimos la tecnología, las personas y la capacidad de transporte que necesitan, utilizando datos en tiempo real de millones de envíos para guiar decisiones más inteligentes. Esto ayuda a los clientes a identificar problemas con anticipación, evitar sorpresas costosas y entregar a tiempo. Uber Freight trabaja con 1 de cada 3 empresas transportistas del Fortune 500 en América del Norte y gestiona más de 17 mil millones de dólares en carga.

title: Finance Intern-MTY

description:
The Organization 

At USAFacts, we believe facts deserve to be heard. We turn data from thousands of jurisdictions into clear, unbiased answers about how government spends money and what it achieves. No political agenda. No commercial motive. Just public service.

Founded and funded by Steve Ballmer, former CEO of Microsoft, we work alongside Ballmer Group Philanthropy and Rainier Climate on civic impact.

As an intern, you’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team and learn how complex public data becomes something the American people can actually use.

To top it off, Fast Company has recognized USAFacts four years running, including the 2026 Most Innovative Companies list. Learn more at usafacts.org and LinkedIn. Learn more about us at usafacts.org and linkedin.com/company/usafacts.

We’d love for you to bring your curiosity, and your conviction that facts matter, to your summer with us.

Your Internship with USAFacts

This is a paid, full-time internship for your penultimate year of undergraduate study, where you’ll do real work on real products. Here’s what to expect:

Pay

$38 per hour for at least 10 weeks, which comes to roughly $15,200 before taxes at 40 hours per week. Interns are overtime eligible, so hours over 40 per week are paid at time and a half.

Housing support

Relocating interns receive company-paid furnished corporate housing and a $1,000 travel reimbursement. Interns who live in the area and don’t need corporate housing can be reimbursed up to $2,000 per month for housing costs with a current rental agreement.

Paid sick days and holidays

3 paid sick days and paid holidays for the duration of your internship.

Hybrid schedule

In the office Tuesday through Thursday, with lunches provided, and the flexibility to work remotely or in-office the rest of the week.

Transportation

You’ll receive either an ORCA card for local public transit or paid parking in or near the building.

Events, community, and opportunities

At USAFacts, we believe a great internship is about more than just the work. Throughout the summer, you'll have opportunities to connect with your fellow interns, build relationships across the organization, and make the most of your time in the Seattle area. From organization-wide events and team outings to boat rides, paddleboarding adventures, and sushi dinners, you'll have plenty of opportunities to build connections and have fun along the way. Each intern cohort receives a dedicated morale budget to plan activities together and make the summer their own. You'll also have the unique opportunity to present your projects and accomplishments directly to USAFacts founder and former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer and other organizational leaders.

The Opportunity

As an AI & Software Engineering Intern at USAFacts, you’ll help build the data and software systems that turn complex government data into trusted insights used by millions of people. Working alongside experienced engineers and product managers, you’ll contribute to designing, building, and testing tools, pipelines, and product features that power USAFacts’ platforms.

You’ll gain hands-on experience across parts of the technology stack, from helping develop data pipelines that integrate and prepare large public datasets to contributing to software features that make data accessible and useful. You may also explore emerging AI capabilities, such as preparing datasets for machine learning or supporting AI-enabled features.

This internship is a chance to grow your technical skills, learn modern engineering practices, and work with a collaborative team dedicated to making reliable information about the country more accessible to everyone.

Key Priorities and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to design, build, test, and document software and data systems.
